description:
Dynamic state lookup for a single market. `:market-id` is the stable Midnight market id and is unique across supported chains, so no chain id is required.

Returns the market state inside a `data` envelope. Use `morpho_midnight_get_market` for immutable market configuration. 404s when the id is unknown.
name: morpho_midnight_get_market_state

chain_id.description: Chain id where the market exists.

current_settlement_fee_cbp.description: Current settlement fee in cbp. May include decimals because the current fee is interpolated.

current_settlement_fee_wad.description: Current settlement fee, WAD-scaled, based on time to maturity.

last_indexed_block.description: Latest block covered by the API when this market state payload was computed.

market_family_id.description: Stable identifier shared by Midnight markets that differ only by maturity.

settlement_fee_schedule.description: Settlement fee schedule at [0d, 1d, 7d, 30d, 90d, 180d, 360d] time-to-maturity breakpoints.

fee_cbp.description: Settlement fee at this breakpoint, in cbp (1 cbp = 1e-6 WAD = 0.01 bps).

time_to_maturity_days.description: Settlement fee breakpoint time to maturity, in days.

tick_granularity.description: Offer tick granularity for this market. Valid offer ticks are multiples of this value.
